ShortDescription.Value: Turn a junction into a complete interchange in one placement (平改立)

Publish.LongDescription:
**section2change (平改立)** places a whole interchange in one go: pick a type, aim at an existing junction, crossing or road (or empty ground), check the preview, confirm.
**13 interchange types** - Four-way: diamond, single-point, Chinese expressway node, cloverleaf, partial cloverleaf, roundabout, stack, turbine - Three-way: expressway T, trumpet, semi-directional T, directional T - Wye (three roads at about 120°)
**Features** - Upgrade existing junctions: matches roads, levels and angle, removes the old junction and reconnects every leg; roads under bridges with enough clearance are kept - Follows curved roads (radius 150 m or more) and places the interchange on the roads' grade - Lane balance with edge-aligned lane drops, pillars kept clear of roads below, grade and clearance checked before placing - Auto mode (point and confirm) or manual mode (every parameter adjustable); Chinese and English UI
**How to use** 1. Open the tool with the button at the top left or Shift + I 2. Pick a type and hover a junction, a road or empty ground 3. Left-click to pin the preview, check the panel, then Confirm
**Please note** - Placement cannot be undone (the game does not support undo) - save first if in doubt - Works best on flat ground with straight, uniform-grade roads - Trumpet, directional types, stack, turbine and wye support right-hand traffic only - Beta: report problems on GitHub with a screenshot and the mod log (turn on debug logging in the settings first)
---
**平改立（中文说明）**
一次放下一整座立交：选立交类型，对准已有路口、立体交叉或道路（也可以在空地上），确认预览后放置。
**13 种立交** - 四向：菱形、单点、中式快速路节点、苜蓿叶、部分苜蓿叶、环岛、定向、涡轮 - 三向：快速路 T 型、喇叭形、半定向 T、定向 T - Y 型分向（三条路约 120° 汇合）
**功能** - 平改立：对准已有路口，自动匹配道路、层高和交角，拆掉原路口并接回各臂；桥下净空够的道路保留 - 弯道（半径 150 米以上）上整体顺着道路弯曲，坡道上按原有道路的坡度整体放置 - 车道平衡（边缘对齐的减车道）、立柱避开下层道路、放置前检查坡度和净空 - 自动模式一指即放，手动模式可调所有参数；中英文界面
**使用方法** 1. 点左上角按钮或按 Shift + I 打开工具 2. 选立交类型，鼠标对准路口、道路或空地 3. 左键固定预览，查看面板里的结果和报错，点“确认放置”；右键退出
**注意事项** - 放置后不能撤销（游戏不支持撤销），必要时先存档 - 最好在平地、平直且坡度均匀的道路上使用；地形起伏大时请先整平 - 立交范围内的道路类型、曲率不要突变，不支持短距离内的 S 形弯 - 喇叭形、定向类、涡轮和 Y 型目前只支持右侧通行 - 测试版：遇到问题请到 GitHub 提交 issue，附截图和 mod 日志（先在设置里打开调试日志）
